title: Allahu Rabbi
intro: Four short sentences that every Muslim child knows by heart: who is my Lord, my Prophet, my book and my religion.

learn.alt: A boy and a girl sitting on a rug, reading their books

learn.label: Learn it by heart
learn.ar: اللَّهُ رَبِّي، وَمُحَمَّدٌ نَبِيِّي، وَالْقُرْآنُ كِتَابِي، وَالْإِسْلَامُ دِينِي
learn.tr: Allaahu Rabbee, wa Muhammadun Nabiyyee, wal-Qur’aanu kitaabee, wal-Islaamu deenee.
learn.en: Allah is my Lord, Muhammad is my Prophet, the Qur’an is my book, Islam is my religion.

items.label: Allahu Rabbi – Allah is my Lord
Muhammadun Nabiyyi – Muhammad (SAW) is my Prophet
Al-Qur’anu kitabi – the Qur’an is my book
Al-Islamu dini – Islam is my religion

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: These are the most important questions a Muslim is asked – and now you know all four answers!

Say it in the right order
practice.prompt: Tap the four parts in the right order.

practice.title: Homework and talking
prompts: 🗣️ Say “Allahu Rabbi…” to your parents without looking at the book.
